name: What factors determine the cost of residential property restoration?

mainEntity.name: What factors determine the cost of residential property restoration?

acceptedAnswer.text: The total cost of property restoration depends on the square footage affected, the structural depth of the damage, and the quality of finish materials selected. Surface-level repairs, such as patching drywall and repainting an interior room, cost significantly less than full rebuilds involving compromised framing, subfloor replacement, and electrical or plumbing rough-ins. In properties with heavy water or storm impact, costs also vary depending on whether you restore with standard builder-grade materials or upgrade to premium finishes like custom tile, marble, or specialty trim carpentry. An on-site inspection is required to assess underlying framing and mechanical needs before establishing a firm price.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs depend on the square footage damaged, structural framing needs, required plumbing or electrical trades, and whether you choose standard repairs or upgraded finish materials.
